description: Essential TOEIC terms focusing on business growth, operations, workplace safety, and professional behavior.

nouns.example: The company has seen a significant growth in international sales this year.

nouns.meaning: sự đảm bảo, giấy bảo hành
nouns.example: The electronic equipment comes with a two-year guarantee against defects.

nouns.meaning: quy tắc, nguyên tắc chỉ đạo
nouns.example: Please follow the guidelines provided in the employee handbook.
It's common to haggle over prices at local street markets.
The handle of the suitcase was damaged during the flight.
The ship is docked in the harbor for repairs.

nouns.meaning: trụ sở chính, văn phòng chính
nouns.example: Our head office is located in the financial district of New York.

nouns.meaning: sở chỉ huy, trụ sở chính
nouns.example: The global headquarters of the firm moved to London last summer.
After a brief hesitation, the candidate signed the job offer.
The highlight of the conference was the keynote speech by the CEO.

nouns.meaning: cuộc đi bộ đường dài, sự tăng vọt (giá)
nouns.example: The recent price hike has caused concern among regular customers.

nouns.meaning: sự thuê, người mới được thuê
nouns.example: The new hires are required to attend an orientation session tomorrow.
All large luggage must be stored in the aircraft's hold.
The city is proud to be the host of the international trade fair.

nouns.meaning: sự nhận diện, giấy tờ tùy thân
nouns.example: Please show your identification at the security desk upon arrival.
The new tax policy will have a major impact on small businesses.

adjectives.example: It's always handy to have a backup of your files on a portable drive.
The report warns that high levels of stress can be harmful to health.
The workers wear protective gear when handling hazardous chemicals.
The marketing team came up with an imaginative solution for the ad campaign.
The new software update requires an immediate restart of the system.
The customer became impatient after waiting for thirty minutes.

verbs.example: We guarantee that your order will be delivered within three business days.
You can sometimes haggle with suppliers to get a better bulk discount.
The customer service department is trained to handle complaints efficiently.
He still harbors hopes of becoming the vice president one day.
Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions.
The company was accused of trying to hide its financial losses.
The presentation was designed to highlight the benefits of the new system.
We plan to hire more staff to help with the increased workload.
The annual shareholders' meeting will be held in the main ballroom.
Our office will host a welcoming lunch for the new interns.
The investigation aims to identify the cause of the system failure.
The budget cuts will seriously impact the department's ability to innovate.
He was arrested for trying to impersonate a police officer.

adverbs.example: She is a highly respected professional in the field of engineering.
If you notice a gas leak, leave the building immediately.
